question: Where was the italian episode of everybody loves raymond filmed?
text: The two-part *Everybody Loves Raymond* episode “Italy” was filmed on location in **Anguillara Sabazia**, a town on **Lake Bracciano**, northwest of Rome. It was shot in July 2000 and opened the show’s fifth season. ([cheatsheet.com](https://www.cheatsheet.com/news/cast-everybody-loves-raymond-italy.html/?utm_source=openai))
